subject: Post-call recap: SOC 2 evidence, audit logs & next steps
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Miller <tom.miller@acme.com>, Sara Li <sara.li@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 05 Mar 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: SOC 2 evidence, audit logs & next steps

Hi Tom / Sara —

Thanks again for taking the time this morning. Quick recap from our discovery so we have alignment and clear next steps for your InfoSec review: 

Key pain points you shared:
- Audit timeline: Acme needs completed SOC 2 evidence and pen-test summary by end of Q2 for your internal audit window.
- Log retention: you require 12 months of immutable audit logs with exports available to your SIEM; some teams ask for 7 years for certain records.
- Data residency & DPA: you're evaluating DPA terms around deletion windows and subprocessors.
- Proof of controls: pen-test results, vulnerability management cadence, and configuration hardening evidence are priority items.

What we agreed we'd provide by EOD Monday (initial handoff):
1) SOC 2 Type II (2026) PDF (redacted where appropriate) — attachment.
2) Pen-test executive summary + remediation timeline — attachment.
3) Our data retention policy + guidance on audit log exports (how to pull, formats) — attachment and Drive link.
4) DPA draft with common redlines we accept and options for additional controls (DocuSign link provided).
5) Schedule a follow-up 30-min call with your InfoSec on Thu next week to walk through evidence.

Open questions for you, so we can prioritize: 
- Which compliance artifacts are must-have vs nice-to-have for your audit (SOC 2 report vs full pen-test details)?
- Do you require on-demand historical exports older than 12 months? (We can export, but some export formats are large.)

Next steps for us: I'll share the requested artifacts and loop in engineering/security for any technical clarifications. Marissa will follow up on procurement/legal items if we need to push DPA language.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments referenced: SOC2_Type_II_Report_2026.pdf, redwood_pen_test_summary_2026.pdf, data_retention_policy.pdf

From: Tom Miller <tom.miller@acme.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, Sara Li <sara.li@acme.com>
Cc: Acme Corp InfoSec <infosec@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: SOC 2 evidence, audit logs & next steps

Hi Neha —

Thanks for the clear recap. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 
- SOC 2 Type II is a must-have; pen-test summary is nice-to-have but we need the executive summary + remediation dates.
- For audit logs: 12 months of searchable audit logs is required; long-term archival (7 years) is only for some compliance records — we'll flag which ones after our internal scoping.
- DPA: we'll share your standard redlines with Legal. Are you able to confirm whether Redwood supports customer-managed KMS for encryption at rest? That will affect our procurement path.

Also, can you confirm the format of audit log exports (CSV/syslog) and whether exports include request/response metadata for tracing?

If you can share the artifacts now, we'll circulate to InfoSec and aim to confirm follow-up time by EOD today.

Thanks,
Tom Miller
Sr. Security Program Manager, Acme Corp
Tom.Miller@acme.com | +1 (617) 555-0123

From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 05 Mar 2027 12:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Post-call recap: SOC 2 evidence, audit logs & next steps

Team — forwarding Acme thread. They tagged SOC 2 Type II as must-have and asked about: customer-managed KMS, audit log export formats (CSV/syslog), and whether exports include request/response metadata. Also need pen-test executive summary + remediation dates.

Can you: 
- Rishi: confirm KMS support options, audit log retention/export formats, and whether we can provide 12 months searchable logs and longer-term archives on request. Also flag any gaps (e.g., retention >12 months).
- Monica: quick check on DPA flexibility re: KMS and deletion timelines.
- Marissa: FYI for procurement conversation and next steps on scheduling the InfoSec walkthrough (Thu suggested).

Goal: I will send artifacts to Acme and set the follow-up once we confirm the KMS/export details.

Thanks — Neha

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Tom Miller <tom.miller@acme.com>, Sara Li <sara.li@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Mar 2027 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: SOC 2 evidence, audit logs & next steps

Hi all —

Quick answers and what we can attach now: 

1) KMS: We support both Redwood-managed keys and customer-managed keys via AWS KMS for Private deployments and Dedicated instances. For Hosted API customers we offer BYOK via an encrypted envelope flow with HSM-backed wrapping (details in attached DPA addendum). If Acme needs strict separation we can propose a Dedicated plan or Private deployment.

2) Audit logs & exports:
- Current retention: 90 days hot searchable logs for real-time queries; 12 months of archived searchable audit logs (index snapshots) — we can export as JSON, CSV, or syslog-compatible events.
- Long-term archival: we can export bundles for long-term storage (S3-compatible) for up to 7 years upon request; automated retrieval may take longer depending on size.
- Export content: exports include timestamp, user identity (redacted per PII rules), request metadata (endpoint, model, token count), response metadata (status, error codes). Full request/response payloads are excluded from standard exports; we can provide limited traces for debugging under NDA.

3) Pen test: attaching the pen-test executive summary (redwood_pen_test_summary_2026.pdf) and SOC2 Type II (redacted) now. The pen-test includes remediation items completed in Q4 2026; we documented timelines in the summary. Full raw reports are restricted but can be shared under an NDA.

4) DPA/KMS language: Monica — I flagged the BYOK wording; suggest a short addendum allowing Acme-managed KMS for Private/Dedicated and the envelope flow for Hosted.

Next steps I propose: 
- Neha/Marissa: share attached artifacts with Acme (SOC2 PDF, pen-test summary, retention policy).
- Schedule the 30-min InfoSec walkthrough — suggested slots Thu 3/11 09:00-10:00 PT or 14:00-15:00 PT.
- If Acme needs raw traces or deeper logs, we can require an NDA and then arrange secure transfer.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Dir, Platform Security | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.ai

Attachments referenced: redwood_pen_test_summary_2026.pdf, SOC2_Type_II_Report_2026.pdf, data_retention_policy.pdf

From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Post-call recap: SOC 2 evidence, audit logs & next steps

Tom / Sara —

Thanks — attaching the SOC 2 Type II (redacted), pen-test executive summary, and our retention policy here for your review. Key clarifications from Rishi below: 
- KMS: BYOK supported (Hosted via envelope/HSM); Dedicated/Private supports customer-managed KMS.
- Exports: JSON/CSV/syslog available; includes timestamps, user id (redacted), request/response metadata; full request payloads excluded unless under NDA.
- Retention: 12 months searchable; we can provide archived bundles to meet 7-year archival on request.

Attachments: SOC2_Type_II_Report_2026.pdf, redwood_pen_test_summary_2026.pdf, data_retention_policy.pdf

Next steps / action items: 
- Acme: confirm whether BYOK is a hard requirement for procurement and flag which record classes need >12 months archival.
- Redwood (Marissa/Rishi): if Acme requires BYOK + Hosted, we need to scope envelope/HSM flow and estimate timeline/cost.
- Schedule walkthrough: Thu 3/11 09:00 PT preferred by Acme — please confirm.

I'll follow up with a calendar invite once we have a confirmed slot. If you want the raw pen-test report, we can share under an NDA — let me know and I will route to Legal (Monica).

Best regards,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
